priceSnapshot.note: This session ran at 06:25 COT rather than the scheduled 02:00, so it covers roughly six hours more of the overnight than a normal midnight report and lands only 25 minutes before the morning session. Everything below is stamped with the real read time. Price is 76,994.5, down 908.7 points and 1.17 percent on 24 hours against the 77,903.2 open, and down 1,040.6 points and 1.33 percent against the 78,035.1 endday mark. Against today's UTC open of 78,195.7 - which is the 14 September daily close - it is 1,201.2 points and 1.54 percent lower. The endday report called this almost exactly: it moved to REDUCE, set the reduce trigger at 77,900.0 and recommended a resting stop at 77,700.0, and both were taken out inside three hours. The shape of the night was a slow bleed rather than a gap. Eleven settled hourly bars since the mark and only three closed green; the 03:00Z bar closed 77,686.3 to fire the reduce gate, the 07:00Z bar closed 76,931.6 to break the 77,135.1 invalidation, and the low of 76,704 printed at 08:02Z. Since that low price has recovered 290.5 points and the last three hourly closes - 76,997.0, 76,980.6, 77,050.1 - are flat rather than falling, which is the first stabilisation of the session.

decisionBox.changed: Position moves from REDUCE to ADD, and the reason is arithmetic rather than a change of view. The endday raised 15.00 USDT of cash at 78,035.1 on a correct bearish call; price is now 1,040.6 points and 1.33 percent lower, sitting on the shelf where the flush actually cleared. Redeploying part of that cash into the long-term core is what raising it was for. It is a STAGED add, not a directional bet: the bias below stays range with a bearish tilt, roughly two thirds of the free cash is deliberately left dry for the FOMC on 16 September, and the reduce gate sits only 290.5 points away. The reduce level falls 1,196.0 points from 77,900.0 to 76,704.0 and is anchored to today's low rather than to a liquidation cluster, because the clusters are now behind price. The add level falls 724.0 points from 78,323.2 to 77,599.2 as the hourly averages come down. The invalidation falls 740.2 points from 77,135.1 to 76,394.9 - the old one was breached at 07:00Z and has to be replaced, not repeated. No resting stop is recommended: the wallet carries no leverage, the next session is 25 minutes away rather than eight hours, and a stop parked above the 76,700 shelf into an FOMC week would be filled by the magnet rather than by a trend.

liquidityMagnet.note: The pull still reads down, but the honest version of this note is that the two numbers disagree about WHY. The measured clusters say the flush is behind price: 1,149,170 USD of longs were force-sold between 08:02Z and 08:12Z, 99.26 percent of the window's total, concentrated at 76,800 and 76,700, and price has held 290.5 points above the low for three hours since with the only short liquidations of the session printing on the way back up. That is the shape of a cleared book. The positioning says the opposite. Open interest is 2,165,293,019.18 USD at 11:29:47Z, UP 5.32 percent from the 2,055,912,361.89 the endday read - about 109 million USD of notional ADDED while price fell 1,040.6 points. And the long-short account ratio has gone from 1.22 at 00:00Z to 1.73 at 11:00Z in an unbroken climb - 1.24, 1.30, 1.34, 1.44, 1.49, 1.60, 1.71, 1.73 - the steepest rise in the series this month. Accounts are not just refusing to reduce longs into a decline, they are adding them with new money, which is the exact configuration the endday flagged as the one that gaps. A book that is liquidated and then immediately refilled on the same side has not been emptied; it has been recycled at a worse price. That is why the add below is staged and small rather than full-size, and why the reduce gate sits 290.5 points away instead of 600.

This is the first reduce gate to fire since 13 September midday and it ends a run of five straight sessions where only the add side triggered. Discretionary calls over the same six: 4 green, 2 red, and adding this session's resolution makes it 5 green and 2 red.
calibration.note: The endday got this right on every gate it set, and it is worth being precise about how right. The 77,900.0 reduce gate FIRED and fired cleanly: it required a settled 1H close and the 03:00Z bar closed 77,686.3, clearing the level by 213.7 points, with the 04:00Z bar confirming at 77,570.1. The 77,135.1 invalidation was BREACHED at 07:00Z on a close of 76,931.6. The 78,323.2 add gate did NOT fire and was never approached - the post-mark high was 78,100.0 and price has not printed a settled close above 77,300 since 05:00Z. The resting stop at 77,700.0 WOULD have filled: the 03:00Z bar traded down to 77,655.9, 44.1 points through it. The endday published range with a BEARISH tilt at 33 bear against 29 bull, and price is 1,040.6 points and 1.33 percent lower, so the tilt was right in direction and understated in size. Discretionary: the endday SOLD 0.00019222 BTC for about 15.00 USDT at 78,035.1 and left futures flat into the gap; that sleeve would be worth roughly 14.80 USDT now, so the trim saved about 0.20 USDT and the decision to hold cash rather than the tranche was correct. Hence true. What deserves to be recorded is the reasoning, because it generalises and it was contrarian at the time. The 13 September midnight lesson said a one-sided long flush on FALLING open interest is an emptied book and therefore a reversal setup. The endday explicitly refused to apply that lesson, on the grounds that the long-short account ratio was RISING through the flush - 1.20, 1.21, 1.22 - so accounts were net-adding to the side being carried out and the book was refilling itself rather than emptying. That distinction was the whole call, and this morning it has been vindicated twice over: the ratio has since gone from 1.22 to 1.73 and open interest has RISEN 5.32 percent while price fell. The refinement for future sessions is that the flush lesson needs the ratio as a second condition, not as a footnote - falling open interest AND a falling ratio is an emptied book; falling price with a rising ratio is a queue forming.
